items.title: Master thesis — Too Late When Deemed a Crisis: Humanitarian Non-Response to Heavy Metal Contamination in the Transboundary Kok River Basin
items.description: Researched how rare-earth mining, entangled in the conflict economy of Wa State, affects downstream river communities on the Kok River in Thailand.

items.title: Briefer — Humanitarian Access Constraints in Myanmar
items.description: Researched and analysed humanitarian access constraints across Myanmar and turned them into a briefer aimed at policy makers.

items.title: Bachelor thesis — Creating Smiles or Frowns
items.description: Researched smallholder farmers in Thailand in an increasingly competitive agricultural market, writing on the political and cultural context and using the Gambia as a comparison case.
